generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Consortium (Limited to maximum of Two(2) constituents including Prime/Lead Bidder) are also acceptable
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall scan the BANK GUARANTEE issued either by a Nationalized/Scheduled Bank OR INSURANCE SURETY BOND issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDA) TOWARDS BALANCE EMD/BID SECURITY and upload the same in the prescribed format in the Karnataka Public Procurement Portal to enable the owner for verification of EMD BG/ISB at the time of opening of Techno Commercial Bid, failing which the offer will be rejected

The Bidder shall ensure that the Bank Guarantee/ISB towards EMD shall be sent in original to the Chief General Manager (Tech), KPTCL, Bengaluru, so as to reach after the last date of submission of bid & on or before the date & time notified for opening of Techno Commercial Bids, in a sealed cover, failing which their bid will not be opened
Tenderer shall upload the legible documents only
Bidder shall not take any deviations on the clauses listed in the No Deviation Certificate Annexure-I

Bidder shall comply with all terms and conditions of the tender. Deviations, if any on the Commercial as well as Technical part shall be brought out clearly in the Schedule-5 and Schedule-6 of the Techno Commercial sheets, respectively

Filled in Techno commercial sheet shall be uploaded along with all other QR documents. Percentage rate Price Offers shall be quoted in Financial offer, provisioned in the e-procurement portal. In case the Prices are uploaded in/along the Techno commercial Bid, then Bid will be summarily rejected. The Techno-commercial sheets shall be uploaded in KPTCL excel formats only
All other terms and conditions as per Tender documents
